tools.name: archive_settled_invoice_pdfs
tools.description: Looks up invoices that were paid more than the given number of days ago and moves their PDF files from the active invoices folder into the dated archive folder. Returns which files were moved, skipped, or missing.

params.name: older_than_days
params.description: Only archive invoices whose payment date is at least this many days in the past.

params.name: customer_id
params.description: Optional customer ID to limit archiving to a single customer's invoices.

params.name: limit
params.description: Maximum number of invoices to process in one call (default 200).

tools.code:
import shutil
import sqlite3
from datetime import datetime, timedelta, timezone
from pathlib import Path

from mcp.server.fastmcp import FastMCP

mcp = FastMCP("billing-archive")

BILLING_DB_PATH = Path("/srv/billing/billing.db")
ACTIVE_INVOICE_DIR = Path("/srv/billing/invoices/active")
ARCHIVE_INVOICE_DIR = Path("/srv/billing/invoices/archive")


def _fetch_settled_invoices(cutoff_iso, customer_id, limit):
    conn = sqlite3.connect(BILLING_DB_PATH)
    conn.row_factory = sqlite3.Row
    try:
        query = (
            "SELECT invoice_number, customer_id, paid_at, pdf_filename "
            "FROM invoices WHERE status = 'paid' AND paid_at <= ?"
        )
        args = [cutoff_iso]
        if customer_id:
            query += " AND customer_id = ?"
            args.append(customer_id)
        query += " ORDER BY paid_at ASC LIMIT ?"
        args.append(limit)
        return [dict(row) for row in conn.execute(query, args).fetchall()]
    finally:
        conn.close()


@mcp.tool()
def archive_settled_invoice_pdfs(older_than_days: int, customer_id: str = None, limit: int = 200) -> dict:
    if older_than_days < 0:
        return {"ok": False, "error": "older_than_days must be non-negative"}
    cutoff = datetime.now(timezone.utc) - timedelta(days=older_than_days)
    invoices = _fetch_settled_invoices(cutoff.isoformat(), customer_id, max(1, min(limit, 1000)))

    result = {
        "ok": True,
        "cutoff": cutoff.date().isoformat(),
        "examined": len(invoices),
        "moved": [],
        "already_archived": [],
        "missing": [],
    }

    for invoice in invoices:
        filename = invoice.get("pdf_filename")
        if not filename:
            result["missing"].append(invoice["invoice_number"])
            continue
        paid_month = str(invoice["paid_at"])[:7]
        destination_dir = ARCHIVE_INVOICE_DIR / paid_month / invoice["customer_id"]
        source = ACTIVE_INVOICE_DIR / filename
        destination = destination_dir / filename
        if destination.exists():
            result["already_archived"].append(invoice["invoice_number"])
            continue
        if not source.exists():
            result["missing"].append(invoice["invoice_number"])
            continue
        destination_dir.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
        shutil.move(str(source), str(destination))
        result["moved"].append({
            "invoice_number": invoice["invoice_number"],
            "to": str(destination),
        })

    result["moved_count"] = len(result["moved"])
    return result

tools.name: stage_and_import_bank_statement
tools.description: Moves an uploaded bank statement file from the inbox into the reconciliation processing folder and runs the statement import job against it. Returns the job's exit status and output.

params.name: statement_filename
params.description: Name of the statement file (CSV or OFX) sitting in the uploads inbox.

params.name: bank_account_code
params.description: Internal code of the bank account the statement belongs to, e.g. 'OPS-USD-01'.

tools.code:
import shutil
import subprocess
from pathlib import Path

STATEMENT_INBOX_DIRECTORY = Path("/srv/billing/bank_statements/inbox")
STATEMENT_PROCESSING_DIRECTORY = Path("/srv/billing/bank_statements/processing")
STATEMENT_IMPORT_SCRIPT = "/opt/billing/bin/import_bank_statement.py"


def stage_and_import_bank_statement(statement_filename, bank_account_code):
    sanitized_statement_name = Path(statement_filename).name
    incoming_statement_path = STATEMENT_INBOX_DIRECTORY / sanitized_statement_name
    if not incoming_statement_path.is_file():
        return {"ok": False, "error": f"Statement {sanitized_statement_name} not found in inbox"}

    account_processing_directory = STATEMENT_PROCESSING_DIRECTORY / bank_account_code
    account_processing_directory.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    staged_statement_path = account_processing_directory / sanitized_statement_name
    shutil.move(str(incoming_statement_path), str(staged_statement_path))

    import_command_arguments = [
        "python3", STATEMENT_IMPORT_SCRIPT,
        "--account", bank_account_code,
        "--file", str(staged_statement_path),
    ]
    completed_import_process = subprocess.run(
        import_command_arguments, capture_output=True, text=True, timeout=600
    )
    return {
        "ok": completed_import_process.returncode == 0,
        "staged_path": str(staged_statement_path),
        "exit_code": completed_import_process.returncode,
        "stdout_tail": completed_import_process.stdout[-2000:],
        "stderr_tail": completed_import_process.stderr[-2000:],
    }

tools.name: refund_invoice_payment
tools.description: Issues a refund through Stripe for a payment made against an invoice, either in full or for a partial amount. The money is returned to the customer's original payment method.

params.name: payment_intent_id
params.description: Stripe PaymentIntent ID (pi_...) that paid the invoice.

params.name: invoice_number
params.description: Internal invoice number the refund relates to, recorded in refund metadata.

params.name: amount
params.description: Amount to refund in major currency units (e.g. 12.50). Omit or pass 0 to refund the full payment.

params.name: note
params.description: Free-text note explaining the refund, stored in metadata.

tools.name: render_invoice_pdf
tools.description: Runs the PDF renderer on an invoice's HTML source to produce a fresh PDF file, then updates the invoice record to point at the new PDF.

params.name: invoice_number
params.description: Invoice number whose PDF should be regenerated, e.g. 'INV-2026-00412'.

params.name: paper_size
params.description: Paper size for the PDF, 'A4' or 'Letter'. Defaults to 'A4'.

tools.code:
import sqlite3
import subprocess
from datetime import datetime, timezone
from pathlib import Path

from agents import function_tool

BILLING_DB_PATH = "/srv/billing/billing.db"
HTML_SOURCE_DIR = Path("/srv/billing/invoices/html")
PDF_OUTPUT_DIR = Path("/srv/billing/invoices/active")


@function_tool
def render_invoice_pdf(invoice_number: str, paper_size: str = "A4") -> dict:
    html_path = HTML_SOURCE_DIR / f"{invoice_number}.html"
    pdf_name = f"{invoice_number}.pdf"
    pdf_path = PDF_OUTPUT_DIR / pdf_name
    page = paper_size if paper_size in ("A4", "Letter") else "A4"
    proc = subprocess.run(
        ["wkhtmltopdf", "--quiet", "--page-size", page, str(html_path), str(pdf_path)],
        capture_output=True, text=True, timeout=120,
    )
    result = {"invoice_number": invoice_number, "exit_code": proc.returncode}
    if proc.returncode != 0:
        result.update(ok=False, error=proc.stderr.strip()[-1000:])
        return result
    with sqlite3.connect(BILLING_DB_PATH) as conn:
        conn.execute(
            "UPDATE invoices SET pdf_filename = ?, pdf_rendered_at = ? WHERE invoice_number = ?",
            (pdf_name, datetime.now(timezone.utc).isoformat(), invoice_number),
        )
    result.update(ok=True, pdf_path=str(pdf_path), paper_size=page)
    return result
